Press {key.linggango_tweaks.stats_gui} to open your character screen.
Lost? The quest book walks you through everything.
Beating a keeper boss unlocks the next tier of gear and tech.
A gold padlock on an item means a boss still guards it.
Heavy attacks can't be parried. Roll through them instead.
Rolling through a heavy attack breaks the enemy's posture.
New kinds of mobs show up as you beat bosses.
The nastiest mobs start spawning after the Ender Dragon dies.
Invasions can hit on random nights, or you can summon one yourself.
On Hard and up, bosses can drop treasure bags.
With Blood Moon on, every fifth night is a blood moon. No sleeping through it.
Keep Inventory is a difficulty option. It costs 10% XP.
The Nightmare Altar eats trait items. Each one adds another roll of the boss's loot.
Sparring Dummies hit back. Great for parry practice.
Sky Arena waves get tougher as you beat more bosses.
Click your head on the title screen to see your medals.
Click stuff on the menu background. The sun too.
